title: Reproduce a duplicate-request regression
prompt:
The branch `benchmark/change` contains one commit that fixes a regression present on `main`: a subscription renewal button could send the same request twice. Do the following.

1. Identify the changed source file and explain the regression from the diff between `main` and `HEAD`.
2. Reproduce it as a Playwright test at `tests/e2e/duplicate-renewal.spec.ts`. The test visits `/renewal`, counts POST requests to the renewal endpoint while clicking the renew button twice in quick succession, and expects exactly one request plus the visible text `Subscription active`. It must fail on `main` and pass on `HEAD`.
3. Write `qa-result.json` in the repository root with exactly these keys: `changedFile` (repository-relative path of the changed source file), `endpoint` (the request path the test counts), `expectedRequestCount` (number).

Do not modify files under `src/`.

fixture.commitMessage: fix: prevent duplicate subscription renewal requests

successCriteria.description: The reproduction test exists at the requested path.
The reproduction test observes the renewal endpoint.
The reproduction test asserts the visible success text.
Product source under src/ is unchanged.
The structured answer names the changed source file.
The structured answer names the counted endpoint.
The structured answer expects a single request.
